notes: Naveh 1974 publishes two inscribed stone fragments found on visits to Kh. el-Mird (no find-spot). The author only supposes the text was 'perhaps' a tomb inscription and says this cannot be verified; he also recalls Josephus on Antipater's burial at Hyrcania. Neither describes a physical grave, pool or pit at the site, so no feature is coded. No plan, no water passage.
